name: defect_interaction
_purpose: EXPLORATORY (TASKS T13 rung 3). Exact, no sampling: does a pair of defects in a flat sheet cost less together (an attraction), more (a repulsion), or exactly twice one (no force)? The cheapest rung of the ladder that asks whether gravity could be a pull between leftovers.
_prediction_written_before_the_run: A contact interaction: zero beyond overlap, negative where the two defects' damage overlaps, because a broken square shared between them is paid for once. If that is the outcome, leftovers attract only by touching and there is no long-range force here, which is a real limit and gets reported as one.
